SAP Functional PM Analyst

PT Chandra Asri Sentral Solusi (CASS) is a subsidiary of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (Chandra Asri Group) established to deliver Shared Service Center (SSC) solutions that support the Group’s growing business operation.

Our commitment is to empower Chandra Asri Group’s transformation and long-term growth by becoming a trusted strategic partner in business support and service delivery.

CASS plays a vital role in enhancing efficiency, standardizing process and driving operational excellence across the Group’s subsidiaries-including entities based in Singapore.

Job Purposes

The SAP Functional PM Analyst is an individual contributor providing functional support, configuration, and minor-change delivery for SAP Plant Maintenance across CASS-served entities in Indonesia. The role is critical for petrochemical/process operations, partnering with Maintenance, Reliability, and Operations process owners and coordinating with ABAP, BASIS, and 3P AMS partners.

Key responsibilities include:

Functional Support & Configuration:
• Resolve incidents and service requests across PM sub-areas — Technical Objects (Functional Locations, Equipment, BOMs), Maintenance Plans & Strategies, Notifications, Work Orders, Confirmations, and Refurbishment.
• Perform configuration, unit testing, and integration testing for minor changes and enhancements.

Change & Project Delivery:
• Gather requirements, perform impact assessment, prepare functional specifications, and coordinate with ABAP for development.
• Lead UAT cycles with Maintenance and Reliability key users; prepare end-user documentation and training.
• Manage transports and follow transport governance to QA/PRD.

Integration & S/4HANA Readiness:
• Ensure PM integration with MM (spare-parts procurement, reservations), FI/CO (settlement, cost centers), and PP/QM where applicable.
• Contribute to SAP S/4HANA Asset Management readiness, including Asset Manager (Fiori) and integration with mobile/IoT scenarios.

Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination:
• Coordinate / oversee Kyndryl, T-Systems, and other 3P AMS partners on assigned tickets and changes.
• Engage Maintenance Planning, Reliability, and Operations process owners on priorities and roadmaps.

Job Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical / Industrial / Chemical Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
• Minimum 2 years of hands-on SAP PM functional experience, with at least one full implementation or rollout cycle in a manufacturing/process plant.
• Strong configuration knowledge across Technical Objects, Maintenance Planning, Work Orders, and Notifications.
• Working knowledge of PM integration with MM (procurement/reservations), FI/CO (settlement), and where applicable PP/QM.
• Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Asset Management and Fiori-based maintenance apps is strongly preferred.
• Familiar with SAP Solution Manager / ChaRM transport governance and ITIL incident/change processes.
• Petrochemical, oil & gas, or other process-industry experience is highly preferred.
• Relevant SAP certifications (S/4HANA Asset Management, SAP Activate) are a plus.
• Strong communication in Bahasa Indonesia; working-level English sufficient for documentation, ticket handling, and coordination with regional/3P teams.

If you’re ready to bring your skills to a dynamic environment where your work makes an impact across industries and borders, we’d love to hear from you. Join us at Chandra Asri Group and be part of shaping a smarter, more connected future. Apply today!

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
